metadata.description: Space: every orbital launch attempt from 1957 to 2025, counted per launch site and year (General Catalog of Artificial Space Objects, Jonathan McDowell, CC BY 4.0). Circle area shows launches that year, color the launching country. It opens on 2025; press Play to replay the space age from Sputnik on.
